I will build my locve a tower by yon pure crystal
fountain, and round it I will pile all flowers
oft he mountain,
Will yo go, lassie, go.

If my true love she were gone, I would surely
find another, to pluck wild mountain thyme all
around the blooming heather.
Will ye go, lassie, go.
title: Wild mountain Thyme
